cards.name: Adhkar
cards.description: One short remembrance at a time, in Arabic.
cards.about: A short remembrance from the Qur'an and the Sunnah in Arabic, a new one every 30 seconds, minute or 5 minutes with a slow fade, with today's date in the Islamic calendar. The morning ones show until noon and the evening ones from the afternoon. The calculation and the idea are from @mashhour134 (pull request 121).

cards.name: Countdown
cards.description: The days left until a date you choose.
cards.about: A heading and the number of days to go until a date: a holiday, a birthday, a trip. Fill in the title and the date (YYYY-MM-DD) on the phone page; the number changes by itself each day. Before the date it counts down, after it the card says how long ago it was.

cards.name: Next prayer
cards.description: The next prayer, its time and how long is left.
cards.about: The next of the five prayers with its time and what is left, worked out on the TV from your place: no network and no account. Choose the place on the phone page, and the method and the Asr rule that your mosque follows. The times can differ by a minute or two from a mosque's timetable. The calculation and the idea are from @mashhour134 (pull request 121).

cards.name: Prayer times
cards.description: The five prayers and the sunrise of today.
cards.about: Today's Fajr, sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha under the next prayer and the time left, worked out on the TV from your place: no network and no account. Choose the place on the phone page, and the method and the Asr rule that your mosque follows. The calculation and the idea are from @mashhour134 (pull request 121).

cards.name: Quote
cards.description: A line you like, with who said it.
cards.about: A short quote in italics with the name of who said it, in three sizes. Type the text and the name on the phone page. A quiet card for a place beside the clock.

cards.name: Year progress
cards.description: How much of the year has gone.
cards.about: The year, the percentage that has passed and the days that are left. Nothing to set up: it updates by itself, and is a nice small card above the dock.
